sources_considered.why: Primary account of the pricing change, its stated rationale and communication failures.
Dated announcement, revised June 30, documenting Auto access and an option to retain request-based pricing.
Independent reporting on customer complaints and the practical change in access.
Funding and growth disclosure does not establish margins or what caused growth.

evidence_items.locator: Section Why did we change the plan?
evidence_items.explanation: Supports the replacement-pricing component. The announcement also acknowledges unclear communication and attributes the change to variation in token costs, but supplies no evidence that unsustainable allowances caused growth.

Qualifies the suggestion of an immediate compulsory replacement for every existing customer. The announcement also describes unlimited Auto access, but does not establish that the opt-out remained available on July 21.

Supports the narrower assertion that the change disrupted some customers' expected access and spending. It does not measure the prevalence of those experiences or establish the claimed cause of growth.

unresolved_gaps: No usable contemporaneous evidence establishes that loss-making allowances materially caused Cursor's growth.
Actual model costs and customer-level margins under the old terms were not established.
The evidence does not quantify how many customers lost comparable access or establish all legacy options available on July 21.
